title: Minimum Amount of Time to Fill Cups
summary: Given an array indicating the number of cold, warm, and hot water cups needed, determine the least number of seconds required to fill all cups, with the option to fill two different types of cups per second or one cup of any type per second.
statement: Given an array indicating the number of cold, warm, and hot water cups needed, determine the least number of seconds required to fill all cups, with the option to fill two different types of cups per second or one cup of any type per second.
constraints: There are exactly three water types and amount[i] cups still need type i.
Each second fills either one cup or two cups of different types.
Return the minimum seconds needed to fill every requested cup.
hints: Two lower bounds matter: the largest single type and half the total number of cups.
A second handles at most two cups, so round total/2 upward.
Return the larger of max(amount) and ceil(sum(amount)/2).
When one type dominates it determines the time; otherwise repeated cross-type pairing reaches the total-work bound.
editorial: When one type dominates it determines the time; otherwise repeated cross-type pairing reaches the total-work bound.

tests.explanation: Four seconds suffice because the largest type needs four fills and other types can be paired with it.
Thirteen cups require at least seven seconds, and balanced pairing achieves seven.
